The sum of forces gathered by [[Beast-Lord]] [[Modon Kira]], for the final civil battle against the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] citizens of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], was known as the '''Beast Rider army'''. By gathering all the Beast-Lords of all the wilderness of Onderon, Kira ammased the largest force of Beast Riders ever seen, and in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], with the assistance of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], laid siege to Iziz.
